newsitem.title: USA: J.B. Hunt to limit capital spending.
newsitem.headline: J.B. Hunt to limit capital spending.

text.p: J.B. Hunt Transport Services Inc said on Thursday that it intends to limit capital spending as the company attempts to maintain its policy of keeping its debt to equity ratio at one to one.
While currently slightly exceeding that benchmark, the limited capital spending and internal cash flow should make the company reach this standard, J.B. Hunt said.
J.B. Hunt said it also has established a two million share buyback program, noting that the purchases would be an "efficient use of capital."
